description: This file defines ASN.1 NGAP protocol structures, including message types, procedures, and containers for 3GPP TS ASN1 NGAP v18.8.0, used in telecommunications signaling. It includes class and method declarations for encoding/decoding NGAP messages and managing protocol information elements.

classes.name: ngap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the NGAP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) as a choice among initiation, success, or failure messages, with methods for encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an initiating NGAP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful NGAP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a failed NGAP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: ngap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Defines the set of NGAP elementary procedures, including initiation, success, and failure message types, with methods for handling procedure codes and message selection.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type for NGAP PDUs or procedures.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
